name: FlowForge
notes:
### New
- AI agents use the models your API key can actually use, picked automatically - no model names to type (fixes "model does not exist or you do not have access to it" with Groq)
- The agent builder suggests your key's models and shows which one Automatic uses
- The Windows app knows all of your download websites, so updates keep working if one is removed
- Test numbers always get their own phone number

### Install
- **Windows:** FlowForge-Setup.exe
- **Android:** FlowForge.apk (allow installing apps from your browser)
- **iPhone:** FlowForge.ipa - unsigned, install with AltStore or Sideloadly

downloads.label: Android app (.apk)
downloads.requirements: Android 7 or newer - allow "Install unknown apps" for your browser

downloads.label: iPhone app (.ipa)
downloads.requirements: iOS 15 or newer - unsigned: install with AltStore or Sideloadly using your Apple ID
